facts.fact: ICASA's draft notice of intention to conduct a market inquiry into the affordability of telecommunications services, printed in Government Gazette 55476 of 30 September 2026, set out a process inviting stakeholder comments on a supply-side questionnaire and public comment, written representations and possible public hearings on a discussion document; the same gazette withdrew the earlier Notice 4130 and the OTT inquiry Notices 4129 and 4148.
facts.system: ICASA market inquiry into the affordability of telecommunications services
